newsitem.title: USA: Omega Environmental in breach of covenants.
newsitem.headline: Omega Environmental in breach of covenants.

text.p: Omega Environmental Inc said on Friday its third-quarter loss resulted in a breach of some of the covenants in its loan agreement with BNY Financial Corp.

The company said it is negotiating with BNY to modify these covenants. In the meantime, BNY has continued to extend credit to the company but increased interest rates by 200 basis points during the default period.
Omega's chairman, Lou Tedesco, said third-quarter results were well below expectations.

"While 80 percent of our loss is attributable to the goodwill and other asset write-offs, one-time adjustments and discontinued operations, the bottom-line indicates that we must accelerate efforts to fix certain businesses," he said.

The company, which provides equipment and services for the petroleum marketing industry, posted a third-quarter net loss of $12.6 million, or $0.28 per share, on sales of $41.0 million compared to a net loss of $1.8 million, $0.05 per share, on sales of $40.1 million the same period last year.

Despite last year's realignment into two operating divisions, environmental services and petroleum services, the petroleum services has not performed up to expectations. Tedesco said he would assume responsibility for day-to-day operations of the petroleum services division.
